title: Nutty Jamaican Sausage Grill
description: A delicious, lacto-vegetarian-friendly Jamaican dish featuring crispy sausage and a nutty flavor profile, perfect for post-workout meals. This recipe is quick and easy to prepare, making it a great option for weeknights or busy days.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes.
Add the Jamaican sausage and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the katsuramuki-cut sweet potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
If using pecans, sprinkle them over the top of the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Transfer the skillet to a serving platter and garnish with chopped cilantro.
